newsitem.title: GREECE: DEH CONNECTS 100MW HYDRO POWER UNIT TO GRID.
newsitem.headline: DEH CONNECTS 100MW HYDRO POWER UNIT TO GRID.

text.p: Greece's Public Power Corporation (DEH) added a 100 MW hydroelectric unit to its national power grid on Tuesday, it said in a statement.
It is the first of three units comprising the power station of the Thesavros dam on the Nestos river in northern Greece.
The other two units will become operational in the coming months, DEH said.
The project, budgeted at 29.8 billion drachmas, is being carried out by a joint venture comprised of AEGEK and unlisted Meton SA.
Along with the natural gas power station to be constructed in Komotini, the Thesavros hydroelectric power station will form the energy centre for northern Greece, it said.
The Thesavros dam also serves the irrigation needs of Drama, Xanthi and Kavala. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
